CLM-ARCH-0198.statement: CAMP improves average 3D-IMC compute utilization from 42.4% to 60.3%.

extra_quotes: CAMP is an offline, software-based solution requiring no hardware changes and improving 3D-IMC compute utilization from 42.4% to 60.3%, delivering up to 2.0× higher 3D-IMC throughput and 1.74× higher end-to-end throughput over state-of-the-art mapping algorithms.
Results are obtained by combining GPU-profiled attention benchmarks with a Torch-integrated 3D-IMC simulator.
The runtime of the proposed algorithm, however, scales quadratically with the number of MVMs being mapped.
